user_goal: Broad multi-agent discovery of existing experimental and clinical datasets; evaluate new and existing publication ideas; write supported journal articles or letters; rank contributions.

scope.focus: EMC-relevant measured data and transferable sarcoma/oncology methods
scope.discovery: Successive agents inspect cached primary sources, actual data inventories, and callable public GitHub source repositories. Search dates and limitations recorded per seat; not an exhaustive fresh archive or literature census.
scope.writing: Supported drafts only; proposal-stage questions do not receive invented Results sections.
scope.repository_changes: New isolated campaign directory; existing manuscripts, preregistrations, scientific graph, patient registry, priority queue and main branch preserved.

coordination.writers: one owner per article; independent immutable Git blobs, no shared reference writes
coordination.local_worktrees: unavailable in this session; remote work branch and worker-owned blobs provide isolation
coordination.legacy_handover: Read codex-handover.json (historical disabled driver); no scheduler cutover or live claims made

scientific_rules: No invented measurements, accessions, analysis execution, patient identities or novelty claims.
Require a new contribution beyond restating original study.
Preserve original-study overlap, assay scope, independent sample units, negative findings, normal context and confounding.
No drug efficacy or tumor protein conclusions from RNA or class-transfer data.
No dispatch to perform blocked downloads/paid APIs/GPU jobs or re-run shelved sequence screens.

ranking_rubric.weights: internal judgments, not journal acceptance probabilities

validation.required: source traceability, independently checked material arithmetic, independent prose and claims review of exact draft blobs, repair verification
validation.normal_preflight: unavailable without a terminal; draft checkpoint only, no main integration or publication readiness claim
validation.journal_submission: not authorized by drafting request and not performed

stop_conditions: Discovery waves return durable evidence-grounded reports, including rejected candidates.
Every supported contribution receives a bounded draft or an explicit evidence blocker; all ranked candidates retain reasoned disposition.
Independent reviewers provide retained reports tied to exact draft content; unresolved findings remain visible.
One isolated branch package preserves sources, methods, actual checks, drafts, rankings and execution ledger.
